newsitem.title: FRANCE: France will not extend car rebate scheme - ministry.
newsitem.headline: France will not extend car rebate scheme - ministry.

text.p: The French government will not extend a new-cars-for-old rebate programme beyond its scheduled expiry on September 30, an industry ministry spokesman said.
"The car rebates will not be extended. It was decided today," the spokesman told Reuters. He said he could not say if any other measures would be introduced to help the car industry.

The year-long programme has buoyed French car sales, which were up 7.4 percent in the first eight months of the 1996. Sales were up 29.4 percent in July and industry sources expect a surge this month of around 70 percent as buyers rush to take advantage of the programme before it ends.
